articles.title: Zoho CRM vs HubSpot for Small Businesses: An Honest Comparison
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: Choose Zoho CRM if sales, operations and finance need to share customer data, you want to customize the system around your process and you want predictable per-user pricing. Choose HubSpot if marketing leads the business and you want website, email and CRM in one product. The biggest cost difference appears at HubSpot's Professional tier, which adds a higher seat price and a required onboarding fee.

articles.title: Zoho MCP: How to Connect Claude or ChatGPT to Zoho CRM Safely
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: Zoho MCP lets an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT use tools in your Zoho apps. Create a server in the Zoho MCP console, add only the tools you need, copy the MCP URL into your assistant and authorize with your Zoho account. Start with read-only tools, keep each user on their own authorization, and require confirmation before any change.

articles.title: Zoho Flow vs Deluge vs Custom Middleware: Which to Use for an Integration
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: Use Zoho Flow for simple app-to-app automation with a few steps; it is metered by tasks, and each action in a flow counts as one. articles.title: Does Zoho Have Manufacturing Software? Zoho ERP, Inventory and Creator Compared
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: Zoho offers a manufacturer three routes. Zoho Inventory handles simple assembly but has no manufacturing module. Zoho ERP, launched in India in January 2026 and sold separately from Zoho One, has bills of materials, manufacturing orders, job cards, work centers, subcontracting and quality checks. Zoho Creator is for custom production apps built around your own process.

articles.title: Migrating from HubSpot or Salesforce to Zoho CRM: A Step-by-Step Plan

articles.title: AI Agents in Zoho CRM: What They Can Do Today and How to Prepare
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: AI in Zoho CRM is most useful today for summaries, drafting emails, data clean-up and prioritizing leads and deals. Actions involving money, customer commitments, deletions or key stage changes should stay rule-based or human-approved. Clean data, a defined process and clear permissions matter more than the AI model.

articles.title: How to Choose a Zoho Development Partner or Developer: A Buyer’s Checklist
articles.keyword: how to choose a zoho developer
articles.author: Arunkumar V
articles.summary: You do not need an official Zoho Partner to implement Zoho; you need relevant, demonstrable experience. Ask to see similar projects, who will do the work, how data migration and testing are handled, and what is documented. Keep the Zoho account in your own name and agree support after launch in writing.
